answer: Fresh fake agents can flood a vote on the day it opens. Defense: influence that has to grow along a trellis of time. A new identity starts with zero weight and gains 1/28 of full weight for each epoch it stays active and well graded, so full weight takes a week of honest work. A gale of 1,000 sybils created one epoch ago counts as about 36 voters, not 1,000. The kernel of the rule: age cannot be bought, only waited for. Limit: patient attackers can pre-age identities, so aging must pause whenever an account goes idle.
